```{r}
merged_df <-readRDS(file ="RCSI_Taxonomy_clin_prot_merged_df.rds")
mc_event_both <-readRDS(file ="mc_event_both.rds")
mc_no_event_both <-readRDS(file ="mc_noevent_both.rds")
```

```{r}
# All event / no-event MCs must be columns in merged_df
stopifnot(all(mc_event_both    %in% colnames(merged_df)))
stopifnot(all(mc_no_event_both %in% colnames(merged_df)))
merged_df_scores <- merged_df %>%
  mutate(
    # summed abundance over bad (event) metaclusters
    bad_abund  = rowSums(across(all_of(mc_event_both)),    na.rm = TRUE),
    # summed abundance over good (no-event) metaclusters
    good_abund = rowSums(across(all_of(mc_no_event_both)), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # raw score: higher = more bad vs good
    score_raw = bad_abund - good_abund
  )

ggplot(merged_df_scores, aes(x = score_raw)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, colour = "black", fill = "steelblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Raw prognosis score (bad - good MC abundance)",
    y = "Number of patients"
  )

```
```{r}
ggplot(merged_df_scores, aes(x = score_logratio)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, colour = "black", fill = "tomato") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Prognosis score (log bad/good MC abundance)",

```
```{r}
grep("adjuv", colnames(merged_df), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
table(merged_df$has_adjuvant_chemotherapy, useNA = "ifany")

merged_df_adjuvent <-merged_df %>%
  filter(has_adjuvant_chemotherapy =="yes")
leiden_cols <- colnames(merged_df)[grepl("abundance_metacluster_leiden", colnames(merged_df))]
cat("Number of metacluster abundance columns:", length(leiden_cols), "\n")
merged_df_dfs <- merged_df_adjuvent %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(dfs_months),
    dfs_months > 0,
    !is.na(dfs_event)
  )
length(merged_df_dfs$dfs_months)
```
```{r}
merged_df_dfs <- merged_df_dfs %>%
  mutate(
    dfs_group_adjuv = factor(
      dfs_event,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("No DFS event", "DFS event")
    )
  )

table(merged_df_dfs$dfs_group_adjuv, useNA = "ifany")
mc_prob_stats_adjuvent <- map_dfr(leiden_cols, function(col) {
  p <- merged_df_dfs[[col]]

  p_event   <- p[merged_df_dfs$dfs_group_adjuv == "DFS event"]
  p_noevent <- p[merged_df_dfs$dfs_group_adjuv == "No DFS event"]

  p_event   <- p_event[!is.na(p_event)]
  p_noevent <- p_noevent[!is.na(p_noevent)]

  if (length(p_event) == 0 || length(p_noevent) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      metacluster          = col,
      mean_prob_event      = NA_real_,
      mean_prob_noevent    = NA_real_,
      median_prob_event    = NA_real_,
      median_prob_noevent  = NA_real_,
      p_value              = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  wt <- wilcox.test(p_event, p_noevent, exact = FALSE)

  tibble(
    metacluster          = col,
    mean_prob_event      = mean(p_event),
    mean_prob_noevent    = mean(p_noevent),
    median_prob_event    = median(p_event),
    median_prob_noevent  = median(p_noevent),
    p_value              = wt$p.value
  )
})

mc_prob_stats_adjuvent <- mc_prob_stats_adjuvent %>%
  arrange(p_value)

mc_prob_stats_adjuvent

```
```{r}
mc_prob_stats_adjuvent_event_p_sorted <- mc_prob_stats_adjuvent %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_prob_event), p_value)

head(mc_prob_stats_adjuvent_event_p_sorted)



mc_prob_stats_adjuvent <- mc_prob_stats_adjuvent %>%
  mutate(
    diff_event_minus_noevent = mean_prob_event - mean_prob_noevent
  )
event_enriched_adjuvent <- mc_prob_stats_adjuvent %>%
  arrange(desc(diff_event_minus_noevent))

head(event_enriched_adjuvent, 10)
```

```{r}
mc_prob_stats_adjuvent_noevent_p_sorted <- mc_prob_stats_adjuvent %>%

head(mc_prob_stats_adjuvent_event_p_sorted)
noevent_enriched_adjuvent <- mc_prob_stats_adjuvent %>%

head(noevent_enriched_adjuvent, 10)
```
